stem:
Students investigate force. The masses they use begin at rest on the ramp. The setup the students use is shown.

Which change will reduce the amount of force needed to move the masses?

options.label: A
options.text: Decrease the height of the ramp

options.label: B
options.text: Increase the height of the ramp

options.label: D
options.text: Pull the spring scale with two hands

visual_elements: Ramp setup with spring scale, masses on a ramp, and a hand pulling the spring scale
